intro: This practice takes about two minutes. Sit or lie somewhere comfortable. Keep your eyes open with a soft, relaxed gaze.
settle: Settle in. Let your body be supported by whatever is beneath you.
paced: Take three long, slow, deep breaths — in through your nose, out through your nose or mouth. Follow the figure.
anchor: Find somewhere you can feel your breath right now — a place that feels safe and comfortable. Tap it.
natural_1: Let your breath find its own natural rhythm. If it helps, touch and hold while you breathe in, and let go as you breathe out.
natural_2: Notice how the in-breath differs from the out-breath — perhaps cool as it enters, warm as it leaves.
natural_3: If a sound or a thought pulls you away, simply notice it, and come back to the breath. Nothing to change.
expand: Now let your attention widen — to your whole body, and then to the room around you.
done: When you’re ready, come back fully alert and awake.
